description: An ordinary placeholder: a Medicare member whose ID is written with spaces, S12345678 then three spaces then 01. This file is keyed by the no-space form, which is the form that is sent. The record returns the ID in its written form, with the spaces, as a source system that holds it that way would.
basis: Synthetic. Every value in this file is invented and no real member was used to make it. The shape of the response is one the mapping tolerates, not one observed from the member API, whose contract is not final.
